name: lessons
description: Open-source school diary for Russian classes: an Android app with a home-screen widget, a Telegram bot as the admin panel, one contract over REST, Connect and gRPC, and the regions’ e-diaries. Build and deploy your own with a console — on Vercel, a VPS in Russia or your own machine. Whoever runs it is the operator. Private by design.

paragraphs: The repository is lessons; the product is called «Дневник», which is what a Russian school calls the paper diary this replaces.
Lessons, substitutions, homework and class events — for schools in Russia. An Android app, an admin panel that lives in Telegram, and a widget of any size that shows what is happening right now.

It accounts for what makes a Russian school different from an abstract one: a six-day week, numerator and denominator weeks, substitutions, shortened days, holidays, and eleven time zones from Kaliningrad to Kamchatka.
